summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to provide a monthly net asset value (NAV) update as of July 31, 2026. The filing discloses the transaction price for each share class equals NAV per share, total NAV of $661.196 million, and breakdowns by component and share class. This is a routine monthly NAV disclosure, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is announced. The filing contains no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or strategic action, and thus does not qualify as a special-situation category.
